name: folia-documentation
title: Folia Documentation
description: Search the Folia Javadoc and PaperMC guides, with a region-aware scheduler cheatsheet and Raycast AI tools.
author: cemyilmazzzz122

commands.name: search-documentation
commands.title: Search Documentation
commands.subtitle: Folia
commands.description: Search classes, interfaces, methods, fields, events, exceptions, guides and FAQ answers in the Folia documentation

commands.name: scheduler-cheatsheet
commands.title: Scheduler Cheatsheet
commands.subtitle: Folia
commands.description: Browse GlobalRegionScheduler, RegionScheduler, EntityScheduler and AsyncScheduler with copyable examples

commands.name: scheduler-code-builder
commands.title: Scheduler Code Builder
commands.subtitle: Folia
commands.description: Fill in a form and copy the matching GlobalRegionScheduler, RegionScheduler, EntityScheduler or AsyncScheduler Java code

preferences.name: docsVersion
preferences.title: Folia Version
preferences.description: Which Javadoc build to index and search.

preferences.name: includeGuides
preferences.title: PaperMC Guides
preferences.label: Index the Folia guides on docs.papermc.io
preferences.description: Index the administration guide, API reference pages and FAQ from docs.papermc.io/folia alongside the Javadoc.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What pressing Enter on a result does.

tools.name: search-docs
tools.title: Search Folia Documentation
tools.description: Searches the indexed Folia documentation and returns signatures, deprecation status, whether an API is unsupported on Folia, descriptions and code examples. Use this before answering any Folia question so the answer matches the real API instead of being guessed.

tools.name: read-entry
tools.title: Read Folia Documentation Entry
tools.description: Returns the full documentation for one Folia type or member, optionally with the list of a type's own fields, constants and methods.

tools.name: migrate-scheduler
tools.title: Migrate Bukkit Scheduler Call to Folia
tools.description: Given a legacy org.bukkit.scheduler.BukkitScheduler method name (runTask, runTaskLater, runTaskTimer, or their *Asynchronously variants), returns the real Folia scheduler API equivalents built from the actual Javadoc signatures, plus guidance on which one to pick. Use this whenever converting or explaining how to port Bukkit/Paper plugin code to Folia.
